title: ThreeByThree
description: ThreeByThree is a lightweight Paper plugin that adds an enchantable 3×3 mining effect designed as a late-game upgrade for pickaxes.
body:
**ThreeByThree** is a lightweight Paper plugin that adds an enchantable 3×3 mining effect designed as a late-game upgrade for pickaxes. It’s built to feel like a natural extension of vanilla gameplay while keeping performance and balance intact.

**Mining Behavior**

- When active, breaking a block mines a 3×3 area aligned to the face being mined
- Only blocks of the same type are affected
- Protected blocks are automatically ignored
- Mining is handled safely to prevent duplication, glitches, or exploits

**Enchant Behavior**

- The ThreeByThree enchant can exist on Diamond or Netherite pickaxes

_The 3×3 mining effect only activates when all conditions are met:_

- The pickaxe is Netherite
- The pickaxe has Efficiency V

**Player Feedback**

- If a player attempts to use the enchant without meeting the requirements, they receive one warning message
- Messages do not spam while holding the mouse button
- Switching to another item and back resets the warning message

**Admin Commands**

_/give3x3pick_

Gives the player a special Netherite pickaxe with the ThreeByThree enchant

Permission: **admin**

_Inspired by Veinminer and the Donut SMP_
